title: TEC PRODUCAO FLEXIVEIS I - EXCLUSIVA PCD
description:
Rio de Janeiro, BR Campos dos Goytacazes, BR Sao Joao da Barra, BR

Missão do Cargo

O TEC PRODUCAO FLEXIVEIS I é responsável, em nível operacional, por um conjunto de atividades a serem realizadas nas máquinas de um determinado processo de fabricação, de forma a garantir que o tubo flexível seja produzido com qualidade, no tempo planejado, economizando recursos, e que as atividades sejam realizadas de forma segura. Atua como operador nas diferentes máquinas da fábrica, executando as atividades de processos, orientado pelos TEC PRODUCAO FLEXIVEIS I e II, também pelo TEC LIDER PRODUÇÃO FLEXÍVEIS.

Descrição do Cargo
  • Realizar setup da máquina de acordo com o tipo do produto a ser fabricado, efetuando a montagem e desmontagem dos ferramentais;
  • Realizar a regulagem inicial do processo, de acordo com os documentos de fichas técnicas;
  • Realizar relatórios diários no caderno de turno da máquina, com as informações de processo;
  • Manter a área organizada, limpa, identificada, realizando a manutenção do padrão 5S estabelecido;
  • Auxiliar na emissão de trabalhos padronizados junto à engenharia, definindo o passo a passo em Excel, e inserindo todas as fotos da sequência da atividade;
  • Manusear e realizar medições com instrumentos de medição como paquímetro, trena, escala, trena para medição de diâmetro, micrômetro, entre outros;
  • Realizar operações com ponte rolante e demais equipamentos de içamento de cargas, e utilizar células de carga para medições das cargas içadas;
  • Operar equipamentos periféricos da máquina principal como transpaleteiras para movimentação de cargas;
  • Realizar melhorias e desenvolver kaizens com o objetivo de melhorar a área fabril e o processo produtivo;
  • Conhecer a ficha técnica dos produtos químicos usados no processo, e acessar as fispqs;
  • Localização: São João da Barra - Açu
Você é adequado para este trabalho se:
  • Formação Nível Técnico (mecânica, elétrica, eletromecânica, eletrotécnica) completa;
  • Vivência na área industrial será um diferencial;
  • Pacote office desejável;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em instrumentos de medição de controle dimensional e interpretação de documentos técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em montagem e desmontagem de maquinários;
  • Conhecimentos gerais em equipamentos de movimentação de carga.

title: Marketing Project Leader - Life Sciences
description:
Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets.

We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

Reporting to the Marketing & Communication Director, Life Sciences, you will be the marketing and scientific lead for Brazil. You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and R&D teams, as well as with external partners (agencies, designers, freelancers).

Responsibilities
  • Develop and manage your area: define the marketing strategy with the Marketing Director, Managing Director Brazil, and Heads of Pharma and Cosmetics; plan, implement, and monitor marketing actions and performance.
  • Create scientific and marketing content: translate regulatory and technical information into clear, engaging messages (ICH‑GCP, ANVISA, BE, biosimilars); ensure compliance with local regulations; prepare presentations, technical sheets, brochures, white papers, and scientific articles.
  • Scientific communication: make complex data accessible to varied audiences (sales, clients, conferences).
  • Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations.
  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.
  • Measure ROI: track campaign results and lead conversions with the sales team.
  • Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners.
Qualifications
  • MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required.
  • Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness.
Desired Profile
  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.
  • Rigorous and results‑oriented, with strong organizational skills.
  • Creative and forward‑thinking.
  • Curious about scientific and market trends.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Motivated by innovation and growth in an international environment.

Workplace Type: Hybrid

title: Supervisor de Mecânica Offshore
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

O Supervisor de Mecânica será responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar todas as atividades de manutenção mecânica a bordo da plataforma de petróleo, garantindo a confiabilidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos ativos, em conformidade com os requisitos de segurança, meio ambiente e desempenho operacional da unidade.

  • Supervisionar e coordenar equipes de manutenção mecânica, assegurando a execução segura e eficiente das atividades corretivas, preventivas e preditivas.
  • Planejar e acompanhar intervenções em equipamentos críticos, incluindo sistemas hidráulicos, guindastes offshore, grandes conjuntos rotativos, compressores, bombas, redutores e sistemas auxiliares.
  • Garantir a integridade mecânica de equipamentos de processo, utilidades e apoio, atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de operações, elétrica, instrumentação perfuração e segurança.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento da manutenção de equipamentos de perfuração, tais como top drive, DWS, bombas de lama, sistemas de elevação e circulação, sendo esta experiência considerada um diferencial.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e manutenção de turbinas (a gás ou vapor), incluindo análise de desempenho, falhas recorrentes e planos de melhoria contínua.
  • Utilizar e manter atualizados sistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/ERP), assegurando a correta abertura, execução e encerramento de ordens de serviço, históricos de falhas e controle de backlog.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar KPIs de Manutenção, tais como disponibilidade física, MTBF, MTTR, aderência ao plano de manutenção, custos e índice de falhas críticas.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração e revisão dos planos de manutenção, estratégias de confiabilidade e análises de criticidade dos ativos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Gerenciarcontratose atividades de empresas terceirizadas, garantindo conformidade técnica, prazos, qualidade e segurança dos serviços executados.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, promovendotreinamentos, padronização de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico);

  • Formação técnica ou graduação completa em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de manutenção mecânica em ambiente offshore.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, guindastes e equipamentos rotativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em sistemas de gestão da manutenção e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Experiência com equipamentos de perfuração e/ou turbinas (gás ou vapor) será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas, boas práticas de manutenção e requisitos regulatórios do setor de óleo e gás.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Você Vai Se Destacar Nesta Função Se For
  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções

  • Motivado pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados
  • Familiarizado com metodologias Ágeis e consultoria (um diferencial)
Responsabilidades do cargo

Atuação estratégica em projetos digitais com foco em CRM, automação de marketing, conteúdo e experiência do usuário. O profissional será responsável por conectar times de negócios, marketing e tecnologia para impulsionar performance e valor percebido pelo cliente.

  • Desenho de jornadas omnichannel para públicos estratégicos (profissionais de saúde), com segmentação, testes A/B, personalização e foco em performance;
  • Facilitação de sessões de discovery e consultoria estratégica, transformando objetivos de negócio em planos táticos mensuráveis;

Requisitos obrigatórios

Para ser considerado para esta vaga, você deve atender aos seguintes requisitos essenciais:

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas — e isso também vale para o nosso time. Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas. Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site.

Os benefícios

Esta é uma posição CLT/PJ no BRASIL - Rio de Janeiro .

Além de um pacote de compensação competitivo, oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade com trabalho híbrido
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, mobilidade internacional e programas de desenvolvimento
  • Aprendizado contínuo, com ferramentas modernas, treinamentos e especialistas da indústria

Os benefícios variam conforme a localidade. Seu Talent Partner fornecerá os detalhes durante o processo.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil. Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner.

Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech é a experience innovation company que existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

title: Postbaccalaureate Research Fellow
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.
Core Competencies
  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines.
Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$20.11 per hour

title: City Manager
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

Our Sales team is essential to driving growth and ensuring the success of our business operations. As a Sales Manager, you will play a pivotal role in leading a high‑performing sales team and executing commercial strategies to expand our client base and foster long‑term partnerships. You’ll be responsible for overseeing the acquisition and growth of new clients, ensuring the delivery of personalized, effective solutions, and contributing to the overall business growth. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, leadership skills, and operational excellence, all while working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

In this role, you’ll be...
  • Manage our Acquisition and Engagement strategy with our Partners
  • Ensure successful business expansion
  • Define Sales Strategic Planning
  • Sales Training and Development
  • Managing Sales Targets, to garantee achivements
  • Data Analitics to better define action plans in‑depth knowledge of the market and competitors
  • Communication and Management Skills
  • Establish and strengthen solid relationships across various areas
  • Support New Line of Business
  • Processes and Continuous Improvement
We're eager to be in touch because you have...
  • 5 years of Experience in a leadership position on Sales (B2B) – Seniority will be evaluated in the selection process, Emotional intelligence, Resilience, Communication, teamwork, Critical Thinking, decision Making, Result Driven and Organization
  • Ingles Fluente, Excel & Power Point, leadership Engineering/Economy/Business Administrations – Flexibility
  • Marketplaces in which it is necessary to form a partnership with an external client and offer it to the user
  • Portuguese and English Fluent
You’ll love working at DiDi because...We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups – 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:
Job Summary

The Reservoir Engineer is responsible for assisting in delivery of safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers. The job consults with operations groups as needed to support the area of expertise and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement of product and service delivery and formally communicates findings. The Reservoir Engineer actively participates in promoting new technology and services offerings and supports the PL in risk management and applying lessons learned to improve job design and execution as related to the area of expertise. They provide real-time support to operations as required.

Additional Responsibilities
  • Provide technical support in the area of expertise throughout the Sales and Product and Service Delivery process.
  • Assist as required with the development of technical job designs for PLs.
  • Assist with identifying areas where new and cost effective techniques can be applied.
  • Explore opportunities for value-added products and services.
  • Consult with Design/Technical Engineer role as required to optimize the technical design.
  • Assist in real-time incident response, recovery, and investigation as related to the area of expertise.
  • Assist in evaluating technical viability and overall appraisal of tenders as related to the area of expertise.
  • Remain current on new technologies.
  • Maintain customer visibility through active participation in professional society activities and calls for papers.
  • Understand the competition’s technical offering.
  • Participate in external technical societies and communities.
  • Contribute, write and review technical publications.
  • Engage with local universities, Customer institutes and research organizations.
Requirements
  • Academic Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field is expected.
  • Language: Intermediate/advanced English
  • Practical Experience: Previous experience in internships, research projects, or working in the oil and gas industry, especially in roles related to reservoir engineering and numerical simulation, would be highly valued.
  • Experience in Numerical Simulation: Proven experience in numerical simulation of reservoirs using specialized software such as Eclipse, Petrel or similar. This includes the ability to model the behavior of fluids in oil and gas reservoirs, simulate fluid flow in different scenarios, and interpret the results.
  • Knowledge of Programming Language: Strong proficiency in programming language, especially Python. This includes the ability to write scripts and programs to automate tasks, manipulate data, create analysis and visualization tools, and integrate different parts of the simulation workflow.
  • Knowledge in Geology and Reservoir Engineering: Solid understanding of the concepts of petroleum geology, reservoir engineering and oil recovery processes. This includes the ability to interpret geological and engineering data to create accurate reservoir models.
  • New energies and sustainability: desirable knowledge of numerical simulation applied to new energies and sustainability, such as carbon capture and storage.
Soft Skills
  • Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex problems related to reservoir engineering, identify effective solutions and implement them efficiently.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Verbal and written communication skills are crucial for communicating results, collaborating with teammates and presenting technical information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Given the dynamic nature of the oil and gas industry and constant technological changes, it is important that the candidate demonstrates adaptability and willingness to continually learn new techniques and technologies.

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Location

Fully Remote (North America / South America)

Opening

There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

Application Policy

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission‑driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8‑figure ARR, and is doubling year over year – with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We’re targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We’re capital‑efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion‑driven: make the signup‑to‑checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can’t optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built‑in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role?
  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team’s output is visible in the company's top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols.
  • First 2 quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking.
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
  • Deliver protocol‑level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude.
  • Ship full‑stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations.
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate.
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations.
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on.
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment.
  • Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity.
Our Tech Stack
  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (required)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding
What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)
  • You’ve led a team of 4–8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained.
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture).
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). JavaScript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster.
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features.
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams.
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process.
Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)
  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce.
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations.
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure.
How We Work
  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones).
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together.
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day.
World‑Class Benefits
  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada).
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies.
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options.
  • Liquidity of options whenever available.
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees).
Interview Process
  • Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory; we will use it as part of our data‑driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  • First Interview: Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be an exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  • Role Interview: You will then meet with Mark P – Head of Engineering and Steve C – Senior Growth Product Manager to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design, product trade‑offs, and compliance.
  • Technical Interview: Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free to use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  • Leadership Interview: Chat with Mark P – Head of Engineering on leading a team, growing engineers, hiring and other aspects of people leadership.
  • Meet the CEO: At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus’s strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note‑taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note‑takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We’re excited to meet people who are energized by complex, ambiguous problems. We look for owners and problem-solvers who are eager to dive into the details of their craft, and are motivated by building products and experiences that meaningfully expand access to ownership.

As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team-matching phase, ensuring that by the final interview, you are aligned with a specific team that matches your strengths and career goals.

High impact domains you might join include:
  • Fund Operations: Building the core engine that powers our vision of an operating system for private capital, simplifying complex accounting workflows.
  • Investor Reporting: Developing features that enable investment firms and audit partners to share accurate, timely performance data.
  • Risk & Compliance: Scaling the infrastructure that ensures security and transparency across billions of dollars in assets.
The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will lead technically complex projects and serve as a multiplier for your team. You’ll work to:

  • Drive Implementation: Lead the execution of complex technical projects, driving them from concept to production while maintaining high standards for performance and reliability.
  • Simplify Systems: Dig deep into our architecture to identify opportunities to simplify code and infrastructure, prioritizing changes that have a measurable business impact.
  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Use the best AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate your workflow, improve code quality, and spend more of your time solving the high-level logic and unconventional problems
  • Foster Growth: Act as a mentor and coach, raising the technical bar for your peers through diligent PR reviews and architectural guidance.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product and design to ensure we are building the right solution for the user, not just following a specification.
About You
  • The Tech Stack: You have experience with (or a desire to learn) our core technologies: Python, Django, React, Postgres, and Kafka. We also utilize Java, gRPC, and AWS.
  • Execution: You can break down complex user stories into actionable tasks and execute them with minimal guidance.
  • Strategic Mindset: You understand the "why" behind your code and can articulate technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Experience: We recommend 8+ years of professional software engineering experience for this level.

title: RJ - Gerente Cyro Casque l| Vendas – Seguro de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)
description:
Overview

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você! Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade.
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações.
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas.
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil.
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Aptidão para vendas.
  • Amplo círculo social (network/rede de relacionamento).
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais.
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor.
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho.
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais.
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais.
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

title: Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4)
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Safety & Security

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions
Your Profile Education
  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field
Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$20,000-$30,000

Descrição da Vaga

Você sabia que somos um dos maiores grupos do setor elétrico brasileiro? Com 120 anos de história, somos um ecossistema de produtos e serviços voltado para liderar a transformação energética, conectando pessoas e empresas à melhor solução de energia e construindo um mundo mais sustentável. Atuamos em 977 municípios de todas as regiões do Brasil, levando energia a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas.

Nosso trabalho mais visível é na distribuição de energia, mas temos muito mais a oferecer. Além das 9 distribuidoras de energia elétrica e 13 concessões de transmissão, contamos com uma central de geração fotovoltaica centralizada e um dos maiores parques de geração distribuída fotovoltaica do país, com a nossa marca inovadora (re)energisa. Também operamos no Mercado Livre de Energia, oferecendo soluções de valor agregado para nossos clientes.

Além disso, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a distribuição e comercialização de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás, e, desde novembro de 2024, com a participação nos ativos da Cegás, Copergás, Algás e Potigás. Estamos também investindo na geração, distribuição e comercialização de bio soluções, como biogás, biometano e biofertilizante, através da Agric.

Nossa missão é transformar energia em conforto, desenvolvimento e novas possibilidades com sustentabilidade. E para isso, contamos com cerca de 17 mil colaboradores que fazem a diferença todos os dias. Você também pode ser parte dessa história de transformação. Vamos juntos construir um mundo mais sustentável?

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do
  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
    • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
    • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
    • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
    • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
    • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
    • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
    • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
  • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
  • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
  • Influencer onboarding flows
  • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
  • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
  • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
  • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel. Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
  • You own the full lifecycle:
  • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
  • First‑session experience and activation
  • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
  • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
  • Conversion to paid
  • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
  • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives. Experimentation & Growth Velocity
  • You will:
  • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
  • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
  • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
  • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
  • Scale winners aggressively
  • K‑Factor Optimization
Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection. Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
  • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
  • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
  • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
  • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
  • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
  • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs. Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
  • You will:
  • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
  • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
  • Revenue performance
  • Funnel metrics
  • Experiment results
  • Key risks and opportunities
  • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
The GM should never be surprised by the numbers Success in This Role Means
  • You are directly accountable for:
  • Paid conversion rate
  • ARPU / LTV
  • D7 / D30 retention
  • Revenue by acquisition source
  • LTV / CAC and payback period
  • Experiment velocity
What You Bring to the Team
  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.
Why Join Mode Mobile
  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.
We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule
What We Are Offering
  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações. Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais. Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

description:
Job Number: Work Locations

Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A Director of Sales manages the hotel sales and marketing plans by recommending growth efforts, monitoring progress, and ensuring that the hotel is competitively positioned within the local marketplace.

What will I be doing?

As Director of Sales, you are responsible for working closely with the Senior Management Team to drive business needs and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. A Director of Sales will work to develop the sales group and groom a high-performing sales team. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage hotel sales and marketing plans to ensure they accurately interpret and support the objectives of the business and use these plans to focus the sales efforts for all market segments
  • Work closely with the Senior Management Team to identify and drive focused activities on elements of the business that require additional support
  • Prepare company contracts for the hotel in accordance with current business and pricing conditions
  • Monitor offers, options and discounts for repeat bookings for groups, congresses and seminars in close cooperation with the Group Coordinator
  • Develop the group team through leadership and by example to include sales development; participate in the hiring of team members, and their future success
  • Direct and manage the forecasting process in conjunction with the Revenue Department to insure accurate, timely and complete information. Compile and/or direct the preparation of reports pertaining to the operation of the Sales Department to include, but not limited to the annual and monthly Forecast, Lead Management System, and Booking Reports
  • Actively participate and complete the preparation of the annual Sales and Market Plan, quarterly updates, and the complexed hotels' annual Budgets. Execute initiatives as outlined; swiftly implement strategies/tactics to offset changes in markets, economy or driven by the competitive set. Organize and/or attend scheduled group and related meetings
  • Contribute to the development of company sales and marketing initiatives by recommending, implementing and monitoring appropriate local activity
  • Organise comprehensive information describing the range of products and services offered by the hotel and deliver this information through relevant sales resources and sales channels to existing and potential Guests
  • Produce accurate and timely reports that meet the needs of the hotel and the management company
  • Prepare and present, on a monthly basis, the contribution, focus and activity of the proactive sales team to the hotel owners and senior management team
  • Cooperate with other departments in the hotel, particularly Reservations and the Banqueting Department, to create an exceptional Guest experience and build strong, comprehensive sales programs
  • Contribute to relevant management meetings to develop and implement sales and marketing initiatives
What are we looking for?

A Director of Sales serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Positive attitude and good communication skills
  • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service
  • Strong leadership skills, whereas it is evident that you can effectively manage and motivate a team to perform beyond expectations
  • Strong analytical skills so to understand key business indicators and competitive trends and develop approaches to these challenges
  • Excellent selling capabilities and the ability and desire to coach selling techniques to Team Members
  • Excellent organisational and planning skillsExcellent grooming standards
  • Flexibility to respond to a range of different work situations
  • Ability to work well under time pressure and/or demanding travel schedules
  • Demonstrated previous experience in a Sales role with the proven ability to close a sale

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Knowledge of the local market
  • Knowledge of hospitality industry
  • A passion for sales and target-based performance
  • Relevant degree, in sales, business development or other relevant business field, from an academic institution
What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

description:
Agence de voyages spécialisée dans la création d'itinéraires sur mesure, cette entreprise conçoit des séjours authentiques et immersifs, principalement en Asie et dans l'océan Indien. Le General Manager H/F est responsable du pilotage global de sa Business Unit. Il/Elle garantit la performance commerciale, opérationnelle et financière, le management des équipes locales et la bonne exécution de la stratégie du groupe. Il incarne la vision du groupe et veille au respect des standards de qualité, des valeurs et de la culture de l'entreprise. La maîtrise du français et du portugais est obligatoire pour postuler.

  • Gérance et représentation légale du bureau

MANAGEMENT

  • Développement d'une culture d'entreprise forte, axée sur la cohésion et l'excellence du service
VENTES & DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL
  • Définition des objectifs annuels et mensuels par destination
  • Suivi des ventes, des marges et mise en place d'actions correctives
  • Supervision des devis et validation des cotations complexes

  • Amélioration continue de la qualité des voyages et de l'expérience client
OPÉRATIONNEL

  • Gestion des situations critiques et litiges 24/7
  • Coordination des paiements prestataires avec les équipes Ops
  • Arbitrage entre qualité, délais et coûts
  • Optimisation continue des process opérationnels en lien avec la Finance
FINANCE & REPORTING

title: Commercial Director
description:
The Commercial Director is responsible for developing a commercial strategy covering all segments and channels to maximize total revenue and profit performance as well as market share penetration of the hotel.

What will I be doing?

The Commercial Director will drive the planning and execution of the commercial strategy and activity through supporting the Revenue Management team, Sales, Catering & Events, Marketing, eCommerce and Public Relations teams, working effectively with area support teams. F&B commercial activities will be a shared responsibility with the F&B Manager, Director of Operations, Area Brazil GM and the Commercial Director.

They act as a role model for the commercial community within the owned and managed portfolio, develop teams and individuals in these functions, and serve as a key business partner to the Hotel General Manager, supporting hotels in deriving the most value from Hilton Sales teams. The role seizes opportunities through strong customer relations and works as an ambassador for the company with owners and key stakeholders.

The Commercial Director ensures that commercial management strategies are set for all revenue streams and that all systems are used to their full potential to yield the highest possible revenue from all available space, whether in Rooms, Meeting Space, outlets or other revenue departments. The role drives overall results, gaining an unfair share through disciplined execution of commercial activities.

A Commercial Director will lead, coach, develop, recruit and retain future talents, manage performance, develop and evaluate commercial team members on agreed KPIs, and work as part of a 4D structure on the property.

  • Directly accountable for driving the top-line budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through to execution using the Hilton Commercial Focus process and all available business tools and intelligence.
  • Deliver at least the budgeted revenues across all revenue streams, including Rooms, GC&E, F&B, Leisure and Spa, with control on cost of sale, route to market, channel shift and marketing/eCommerce opportunities.
  • Work with the GM, Finance and Operations Director to ensure profits are maximized in line with TGOP and EBITDA targets set.
  • Ensure Business Review Guidelines (current to +5 years) and all pricing & rate quotation strategies are in place to maximize all pricing components of sales and catering opportunities and achieve positive group market share.
  • Support various on‑property, RDOS’s, and area marketing teams in coordinating hotel‑level marketing, sales and public relations activities, liaising with regional support and brand teams to maximize performance.
  • Support the Cluster Revenue Managers/On Property Revenue Manager and RMCC to establish an optimal mix, review and validate forecasts, develop strategies for different demand periods, and review and approve retail and group pricing strategies.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with all stakeholders, owners, hotel teams, Hilton matrix support teams to ensure commercial benefits of the hotel.
  • Liaise with VP of Operations, present commercial strategies to Regional Team and key stakeholders.
  • Consistently conform to Hilton brand standards and corporate identity and utilize all communication tools under the guidance of regional marketing and BPS.
  • Keep in touch with market trends and review/amend strategies accordingly in line with evolving market conditions.
  • Participate in the leadership activity of the Hotel and Region.
What are we looking for?
  • Minimum of 3+ years hospitality/travel industry experience in a revenue‑generating or commercial services role.
  • Minimum of 3+ years experience presenting sales plans, presentations, etc. to senior‑level executives and constituent groups.
  • 3+ years experience working in a collaborative/matrix environment.
  • 3+ years working with departmental financial data to make strategic/tactical decisions.
  • 3+ years experience evaluating and identifying business opportunities for a business.
  • At least 3 years of experience managing a sales or commercial team.
  • Fluent in English.

It would be advantageous to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • 3+ years working in a multi‑complex hotel/travel industry environment.
  • Experience in multiple disciplines with knowledge of Marketing, E‑commerce and Finance.
  • Local language, strong attribute to have.
What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full‑service hotels and resorts to extended‑stay suites and mid‑priced hotels. For more than a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing team members are at the heart of it all!
